findings_qualitative.value: GI can operate beyond ~52 AU; bodies can undergo inward type II migration

evidence.quote: GIs can occur in the region beyond $r \sim$ 52 AU, where both of the conditions are simultaneously met.

claims.hypothesis: Gaps are opened by planets of what mass?
claims.experiment: Hill radius and Kanagawa gap-depth analyses
claims.result: Kanagawa masses 0.5-0.85 MJ; Hill gives 88.8 MJ for innermost gap
claims.finding: Masses comparable to or less than Jupiter; Hill method overestimates

evidence.quote: The results show that the computed value of the mass at all of the gaps becomes comparative or less than a Jupiter mass

claims.hypothesis: GI can form the bodies in the outer disk
claims.finding: GI is likely for outer gaps

evidence.quote: the GI is very likely to be a mechanism for the gaps at $r=65.2$ and $77.2$ AU

claims.hypothesis: Inner gaps arise from migrated bodies
claims.result: Type II migration likely for all bodies
claims.finding: Conjecture: GI formation plus inward migration

evidence.quote: we conjecture that all of the observed gaps may be a consequence of bodies that might have originally formed at the outer part of the disk

why_this_method.value: Re-process to improve images for more accurate mass estimates

evidence.quote: we re-process the ALMA archive data because a better quality of the dust continuum maps is desired
This may suggest that the method itself is over-simplified, and hence leads to a significant overestimate of planetary masses.

limitations_admitted.value: Only 17 of 780 baselines exceed 10 km; images could be improved

evidence.quote: only 17 out of 780 antenna combinations had a baseline of more than 10 km

referee_caveats_inferred: Imaging parameters missing; gap properties depend on reprocessing
Low-mass planet masses depend on assumed alpha and aspect ratio
Dust continuum used with a gas disk model from lower-resolution data
Relaxed minsnr/minblperant flagging may bias the image

data_public_as_stated.value: Public in ALMA science verification archive

evidence.quote: All of the data including observed raw visibility data, calibrated data set, and images are available in the ALMA science verification data archive.

reproducibility.score_reason: Public data and numbers, but imaging parameters and model inputs missing.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Imaging recipe incomplete and mass estimates depend on unstated parameters.
